chunks: And Salamah ibn al-Khattab narrated from Isma'il ibn Ishaq, from Isma'il ibn Aban, from Ghiyath, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his grandfather, from 'Ali عليه السلام, who said:
The minimum period a woman carries a pregnancy is six months, and the maximum period she carries is two years.
ai.seo_question: What is the minimum and maximum duration of pregnancy in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding the minimum and maximum recognized duration of pregnancy. It is relevant to family law and judicial determinations connected to pregnancy, lineage, and rulings concerning a pregnant woman.
